about: Static facts per LLM provider: endpoint, key variable NAMES (never values), privacy tier with evidence (docs/providers.md), limits. Chain ORDER is not here: it is generated by scripts/bench-providers.ts into config/provider-order.json. Checked 28 Oct 2026.

ollama.evidence: Runs on this machine; nothing leaves the server.

groq.evidence: Services Agreement s.4.2: 'Groq is not permitted to use Inputs or Outputs for training or fine-tuning any AI Model Services or other models' (https://console.groq.com/docs/legal/services-agreement). 'By default, Groq does not retain customer data for inference requests'; data in US GCP buckets (https://console.groq.com/docs/your-data).

cerebras.evidence: Terms: 'does not grant Cerebras the right to use Service Content for the purpose of training or fine-tuning models' (https://www.cerebras.ai/terms-of-service, 27 Aug 2024). Privacy: 'We do not retain inputs and outputs associated with our training, inference and chatbot Services' (https://www.cerebras.ai/privacy-policy). Data 'may be stored and processed in the United States and other countries'.

together.evidence: 'We do not use any data collected from you to train our models without your explicit opt-in and consent' (https://www.together.ai/privacy, 17 Dec 2025). The configured key is rejected (HTTP 401) on 28 Oct 2026.

gemini.evidence: Unpaid services: 'Google uses the content you submit to the Services and any generated responses to provide, improve, and develop' its products; 'human reviewers may read, annotate, and process your API input and output' (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms, 28 Apr 2026).

openrouter.evidence: Each upstream provider has its own data policy; 'there are separate settings for paid and free models'; training opt-in is an account setting not readable through the API (https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/privacy/provider-logging). Free tier: 50 free-model requests a day (GET /api/v1/key).

deploy.evidence: Castle Global, Inc. (dba Deploy), San Francisco. The privacy policy (https://deploy.com/privacy, 23 Oct 2026) does not mention API prompts, model training or model providers; 'may be processed and stored in the United States or other countries'.

bedrock.evidence: Not verified: no AWS access yet. Disabled until BEDROCK_ENABLED=true.
